seoTitle: Leap Year Checker with the Rule and Upcoming Leap Years
metaDescription: Check if a year is a leap year, see the rule that applies and list the next eight leap years. Free.
intro: Tells whether a year is a leap year under the Gregorian rule, explains why and lists upcoming leap years.
why:
The rule is: divisible by 4, except centuries, unless divisible by 400. So 2000 and 2028 are leap years and 1900 and 2100 are not.

Enter a year to see the reason and how many days it has. Before the Gregorian reform of 1582 (later in some countries) the Julian rule applied, which is not modelled.
howTo: Read the answer and the rule.
